notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/878990/

Development is still in progress. I was hoping to release sooner, but my two initial prototypes and associated iterations haven't met my standards for engaging gameplay.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33093032/3495d6188972849fb34f847c5f7d81fa1526111f.png[/img]

At a minimum, I am currently drawing inspiration from Darkest Dungeon, mockumentaries, and the global financial crisis. The challenge is striking the right tone - dark, but not too dark. This is a [b]game [/b] more than an art-piece, and life is hard enough, right? :)

I highly value solid animation, thoughtful writing, and meaningful experiences. I will do my best to deliver all of these.

-rock

notes.title: Release Timeline + Feature Requests? (Please comment here!)
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/878990/

Please post your feature requests here! Don't be shy, even simple ones help.

Think of games you may already love, like Stardew Valley, Darkest Dungeon, The Sims, etc. I'd like to at least have a couple of people share some requests. (You could even weigh on in things you don't like to see in these kinds of games.)


-rock
